Subject: Recap: Renewal + New Inference Workloads — Next steps

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick written recap so we have aligned next steps and assumptions from the call. High-level summary: 

Pain points we heard
- Peak latency variability on large batch jobs during end-of-day reports (~400–600ms tail currently).
- Cost unpredictability when spikes hit (inference spend increases 2.5x during batch windows).
- Need for stricter SLAs and access controls for regulated models (PII handling).

Goals
- Stabilize tail latency to <250ms for interactive flows.
- Move high-volume nightly scoring to an efficient Dedicated pool and reduce token unit cost by ~30%.
- Establish a 2-week pilot to validate Dedicated capacity + prefix caching on a non-prod workload.

What we propose (next steps + owners)
1) Pilot scope: Dedicated GPU pool for nightly scoring + one interactive route on hosted with caching. (Owner: Markus)
2) Technical deep-dive: SRE & SE call to validate QPS and KV-cache integration (Owner: Dev) — propose Wed 30 Mar, 10am PT.
3) Procurement intro & SOW: send SOW template and pricing anchor; procurement to confirm PO cadence (Owner: Lydia / Novafin).
4) Success metrics: end-to-end P99 latency target, 30% cost/unit reduction on pilot traffic, and clean audit logs for model access (Owner: Monica).

Numbers we used on the call (please confirm or correct):
- Current tokens/day (avg): 18M
- Peak interactive QPS (business hours): ~55 QPS
- Nightly batch peak: 1.2M tokens over 30 minutes (burst)

Attached: usage_report_q1.csv (sample traffic), initial_pricing_estimate.xlsx (anchor numbers).

Please reply with any corrections, confirm the Wed 30 Mar slot for the SRE call if that works, and loop in procurement contact for PO/SOW.

Best,
Markus

Appreciate the clarifications — couple quick updates and a suggested pilot plan: 

Suggested pilot (90% of what we discussed):
- Duration: 2 weeks (non-prod run 1 week, production pilot 1 week)
- Capacity: Reserve a 4-GPU Dedicated pool (NVIDIA H100 equiv) with an autoscale floor to handle 150 QPS burst headroom.
- Config: Continuous batching for nightly scoring + prefix/KV caching on the interactive route.
- Pricing anchor (draft): committed monthly for pilot-equivalent capacity prorated to 2 weeks — see attached pricing_v3.pdf for numbers and optional conversion to a 3-month pilot.

Immediate asks from Novafin to finalize pilot:
- Confirm the subset of traffic we should mirror (list of endpoints or HubSpot ticket) — Ethan
- Procurement to confirm SOW acceptance window and PO lead times — Procurement
- Confirm Wed 30 Mar, 10am PT for SE deep-dive (Dev)

I’ve attached pricing_v3.pdf with three options: exploratory pilot (2 weeks), short committed pilot (1 month), and 3-month pilot with a deeper discount. If the team wants a shorter ramp, we can do an interactive-only pilot first and add the batch job after validation.

Next meeting invites coming once we lock Wed 30.

Thanks,
Markus
